Overview

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Attacks starting from Upgrade 7 are able to hit air type enemies.

Passive Ability: Shade Birth

Summons a Shade Birth after taking down 10 enemies (max 3), the Shade Birth will have 5x of his displayed damage.

  • Zombie (Risen) increases the amount of HP the Shade Birth spawns in by 25% of each placement (up to 200%). Buffs to Supreme Being (Sovereign) by Elfy (Slyph), Wind Dragon or Idol, do not affect the amount of HP the Shade Birth spawns with.
  • Griffin (Reincarnation) and Commander increase the amount of damage Shade Birth does when colliding with an enemy.
  • You can increase the damage the Shade Birth does by increasing Supreme Being (Sovereign)'s base damage stats: having high stat potential, Traits that increase damage and Relics.
  • Shade Birth does not do Dark damage like Supreme Being (Sovereign), instead only doing physical.

Active Ability: Nihilism

Once Activated, a 12-second interval will appear above Supreme Being (Sovereign), once the time ticks down to zero, any enemy in the range of Supreme Being will take 5x of his damage, enemies who are caught by this also have a purple effect around them.


Selling

Unit sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • He is the second Secret unit added in the game that is not limited-time. The first unit being Lulu.
  • In the winter event his Shade Births have a spawn cap of 3 per path and thus can have 9 of them at the same time.
  • Before update 18.5, he need at least 50 kills in order to summon a Shade Birth. From update 19.0, his passive requirement has been buff with only required 1 kill in order to summon.
    • However from update 19.5, he has received a nerf, making his kill requirement into 10 kills in order to summon.
